property_summary: For any caller and any queried address, c.approvedToLog(q) must return exactly the approval status the owner assigned to q via setApprovedLogger, regardless of who calls it; the mutant instead returns the caller's own status, so an approved caller querying an unapproved address gets true in the mutant but false in the reference.
change_summary: Look up the caller's own approval status (msg.sender) instead of the _caller argument.
